task.title: Relics: validate the links document only when links change
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M65). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

Every relic fold validates the whole links document again (up to 2,000 IDs and task-ID checks), even when the change holds no link operation.

## Wanted

Validate the links document only when the change being folded adds or removes a link.

## Done when

- A fold with no link operation does not walk the links document.
- A damaged links document is still refused when read from stored data.
